verdict.rationale: ADK's official docs explicitly document how to expose ADK tools via an MCP server ('build an MCP server that wraps ADK tools, making them accessible to any MCP client'), showing the framework supports the server side of MCP, not just being an MCP client. However, this is a build-your-own-server guide rather than a turnkey, pre-hosted official MCP endpoint, so it requires developer setup work. Missing for 10: a ready-made hosted/official MCP server endpoint, independent hands-on confirmation that the generated server works reliably with third-party MCP clients.
